summary: Compute-intelligence software that predicts AI and HPC workload requirements before execution.
editor_note: The sharp idea is temporal: instead of explaining GPU waste after a job runs, Expanse predicts GPU, CPU, memory, runtime and completion risk before resources are committed. It installs inside customer-controlled SLURM, Kubernetes or Nomad environments and keeps recommendations tied to observed execution evidence. The published efficiency figures are company reported, so broader independent validation remains the key risk.

product_evidence.claim: Expanse Analyse predicts GPU allocation, memory use, runtime and failure risk before an AI or HPC job enters the queue.
The platform integrates with SLURM, Kubernetes and Nomad and keeps code, logs, telemetry and job data inside customer-controlled infrastructure.

market_context.primary_user: Infrastructure and research-computing teams operating shared GPU or HPC clusters.
market_context.differentiation: Makes evidence-bound resource and completion predictions before execution, rather than limiting analysis to post-run monitoring.
market_context.why_now: Constrained GPU capacity makes workload right-sizing more valuable than simply procuring additional hardware.

risks.claim: Reported waste reduction and prediction accuracy are company supplied and may not generalize across workloads, schedulers or customer environments.
risks.basis: VentureDex assessment of Expanse's official product pages and financing announcement.
